title: rsa_sha256_sign re-parses PEM on every signing
description: src/federation.rs:532-545. The ponytail comment at line 532 already notes this: PEM is re-parsed on every sign call. For delivery, each outbound activity parses the RSA private key from PEM, which involves ASN.1 decoding and allocation. The delivery worker sends potentially hundreds of activities per batch. Parsing a 2048-bit RSA key from PEM is ~10-50 microseconds — not catastrophic, but wasteful. The comment notes caching the parsed key in AppState as the upgrade path.
